تحتفظون (form VIII)
# تَحْتَفِظُونَ (taḥtafiẓūna) /taħ.ta.fi.ðˤuː.na/: second-person masculine plural non-past active indicative of اِحْتَفَظَ (iḥtafaẓa)
# تُحْتَفَظُونَ (tuḥtafaẓūna) /tuħ.ta.fa.ðˤuː.na/: second-person masculine plural non-past passive indicative of اِحْتَفَظَ (iḥtafaẓa)
maddeler.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
